historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is not a usable growth proxy: book value fell from 21,113 (FY2020) to 13,372 (FY2022) because dividends ran at 160-250% of earnings in FY2021-22 (special payouts), and payout has been ~100% since. EPS and FCF 3yr CAGRs (19.6%, 60.3%) are off a FY2022 trough (input-cost squeeze, FCF 1,236) and describe margin recovery, not growth. Revenue is the honest anchor: 3.2% over 5 years, ~0% over 3.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF in every year (SBC <= 44m against FCF of 1.2-6.4bn, nil since FY2023; interest received sits in investing), so the SBC-adjusted and reported FCF CAGRs coincide. All growth since FY2023 has come from gross margin (30.4% -> 34.8%) on flat revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: Master Kong stays the #1 noodle and #1-2 RTD beverage brand in a zero-sum ('stock competition') Chinese F&B market. Revenue grows 1.5-3% a year on price/mix and new channels while traditional-channel noodle volumes keep shrinking (industry -14.5% H1 2026). The FY2023-25 gross-margin recovery (30.4% -> 34.8%) is mostly held, giving EBITDA of ~13.5%. Payout stays ~100% of profit; the business is a ~7% owner-FCF yield bond with low growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: The new CEO's efficiency agenda, sugar-free/functional tea and premium non-fried noodles, and the PepsiCo China portfolio (Starbucks RTD coffee, Gatorade) restore 4-5% revenue growth while instant retail and membership channels scale. Input costs stay benign and EBITDA margin reaches ~14.7%, a level near the company's own pre-2021 peak economics.
scenario_narratives.bear: Low-price challengers (Baixiang) and snack-discount formats take share and block price increases, as both Tingyi and Uni-President's public denials of price hikes already suggest. Raw materials normalise against the company, EBITDA margin falls to 11.5%, and revenue shrinks for two years before stagnating at ~1%. PepsiCo licence economics are a further tail risk not explicitly modelled.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A mature, cash-generative Chinese staple valued on consolidated owner FCF with NCI leakage folded into the tax rate, discounted at an RMB-built 8% and converted to HKD. Terminal value capped at 15x FCF (structurally slow-growth). The investment case is yield plus modest growth; upside requires margin to hold, not grow.
key_risks_to_valuation: Margin mean-reversion: gross margin +4.4pp since FY2023 is largely input-cost driven; each 1pp of EBITDA margin is ~RMB0.8bn of pre-tax flow
Revenue stagnation in a 'stock competition' market with traditional-channel noodle volumes falling double digits
PepsiCo China licence economics/renewal (large share of beverage revenue)
RMB/HKD rate: values are computed in RMB and converted at 1.1721; a 5% RMB move moves the HKD value 5%
Cash-tax leakage: PRC dividend withholding on upstreaming is inside the 36.5% combined rate

inputs.share_count_basis: Weighted diluted share count from the H1 FY2026 EPS note (5,636.8m; FY2025 5,637.1m). Held FLAT: SBC is immaterial (RMB0.5m FY2022, nil FY2023-25) and no buybacks have been executed; the newly approved buyback mandate is an authorisation only, so the flat count is a modelling convention rather than one the company is funding.
inputs.cash_composition: 30-Jun-2026: bank balances and cash 15,211.8 + current portion of long-term time deposits 4,677.6 + long-term time deposits 3,770.5 + pledged deposits 9.9 = 23,669.8 (ties to the interim highlights 'cash at bank and on hand (including long-term time deposits) RMB23,669.818 million'). Debt = long-term 5,798.4 + current 11,595.0 interest-bearing borrowings; lease liabilities (196.6) excluded under lease treatment B.
inputs.reported_fcf_basis: FY2025 OCF 8,201.7 less PPE 3,071.2 and land-use rights 40.4 = 5,090.0 (consolidated, includes the NCI share). OCF is already after interest paid (310.2) and cash tax (1,981.9).
inputs.sbc_source: Metrics.csv StockBasedComp: FY2017 44.2 declining to FY2022 0.5, nil FY2023-FY2025; no equity-award tax withholding (EquityAwardTaxes 0 all years). SBC-zero market: rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest received (FY2025 RMB297.8m; H1 FY2026 88.8m) is classified in INVESTING activities under HKFRS here, so reported FCF (OCF - capex) does not contain it and nothing is stripped from last_fcf. The forward EBITDA build likewise excludes P&L interest income (310.5m) and the cash/time deposits that earn it are in the bridge, so the cash is counted once.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per RMB 1.1721 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z). Cross-check via USD legs: HKD=X 7.8472 / CNY=X 6.683 = 1.1742, a 0.2% tie, confirming direction (model RMB -> quote HKD multiply). No dual listing to parity-check. All flows and per-share values computed in RMB, converted to HKD at this rate; refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate, so re-date it on any later refresh.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z regular close (HKEX; last trading session before valuation date)
inputs.wacc_rationale: RMB-built, since the flows are RMB: China 10y government bond ~1.9% + beta 0.80 x China ERP 7.0% = 7.5% cost of equity, +0.5pp for the Cayman/VIE-free but controlling-family HK holding structure and RMB capital-account friction on upstreaming (10% PRC dividend WHT is in the flows, not here). Net cash, so WACC ~ cost of equity: 8.0%, identical in all three scenarios (risk charged once, in the flows).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease payment (FY2025 194.5m, principal + interest per note 37(b)(i)) charged as lease_cost_pct 0.25% of revenue; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 D&A 3,630.3 less ROU depreciation 316.7 = 3,313.6, 4.19% of revenue); lease liabilities (196.6m at 30-Jun-2026) EXCLUDED from net debt. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, in the flows: NCI took 13.0% of FY2025 profit (675.2 of 5,175.9), concentrated in beverages. Folded into a combined tax/leakage rate: 1 - (1 - 27% cash tax incl. PRC dividend WHT) x (1 - 13%) = 36.5%. Calibration: FY0 EBIT on the treatment-B build 10,187 - 194 - 3,314 = 6,680 x (1 - 36.5%) = 4,242 vs reported attributable NPAT 4,500.7 less ~300 after-tax Asset Activation disposal gains and 113 associate/JV share = ~4,090-4,200; ties within ~3%. No NCI deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF with the non-US adaptations (RMB flows / HKD quote, SBC-zero, lease treatment B, NCI as leakage, excluded associate and FVPL income with matching assets in the bridge). Routed as a non-US consumer-staples operating company (instant noodles + RTD beverages incl. PepsiCo China bottling); not a bank/REIT/holdco/LIC. FY0 underlying EBITDA = PBT 6,965.9 + finance costs 320.8 - interest income 310.5 - associates/JVs 112.8 - gain on disposal of subsidiaries 306.7 (Asset Activation Programme, one-off) + D&A 3,630.3 = 10,186.9 (12.88%). H1 FY2026 company EBITDA 5,644.9 (13.9%, +3.6% y/y) on revenue +1.1%. Working capital is structurally negative (cash-before-delivery: receivables 1,410 + inventory 3,650 vs payables 7,866 + customer advances 2,160 at Dec-2025, ~-6% of revenue), so growth RELEASES cash: wc_capture +6% of the revenue change. BALANCE-SHEET TIMING: net cash is from the 30-Jun-2026 interim, which (i) still holds the FY2025 final dividend of RMB4,500.8m approved in H1 but paid after 30 June (other payables 9,474 -> 14,682; no owner dividend in the H1 cash-flow statement) and the current price is ex that dividend, and (ii) already contains H1 FY2026 cash generation that the FY2026 (Y1) projection counts again. Both are deducted in equity_bridge so the effective opening net cash equals the Dec-2025 position less the dividend paid since. Buybacks: none executed (buyback_cash 0); payout policy has been ~100% of attributable profit.

bear.narrative: Stock competition: Baixiang-style discounting and snack-discount channels cap pricing, input costs (palm oil, PET, sugar) normalise upward, and EBITDA margin gives back about half the FY2023-25 recovery to 11.5%; revenue declines two years then crawls at 1%.

base.narrative: Flat-volume, mix-led staple. FY2026 revenue +1.5% (H1 +1.1%), EBITDA margin 13.2% (H1 13.9% vs 13.6%) holding the premiumisation and input-cost gains but not extending them much; low-single-digit nominal growth thereafter as channel shift (instant retail, snack discount, clubs) offsets traditional-channel decline.

bull.narrative: New CEO's 'Back to Day 1' efficiency push and premium/sugar-free beverage mix lift EBITDA toward 14.7%; emerging channels and PepsiCo portfolio launches return revenue to mid-single-digit growth for five years.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (up from 15%): the last three years of earnings growth were margin on flat revenue, which is reversible, and the category is in share-based competition. Base 50%: H1 2026 is tracking it (revenue +1.1%, EBITDA +3.6%). Bull 25% (down from 35%): it needs revenue re-acceleration in a deflationary consumer market AND further margin expansion, two independent things going right.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
